title: Retire `inlineEdit: true` on master-detail relationships: after #35889 a parent field group decides, so the key means the same as absent
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filed from #35889 slice S1 (PR #35921), which names it as a follow-up. Part of epic #35590 (record page redo).

## Why
After #35889 (maintainer 2026-11-20 17:35:23Z 「一律只看分组」, ruling record 7046311205 on #35889), a master-detail child table joins the parent's form and record edit only when a parent field group names it. `inlineEdit: true` on the relationship no longer changes anything: it reads the same as leaving it out. A declared key that does nothing is the case ADR-0049 (enforce or remove) covers.

## To do
Retire the key on the ADR-0049 / ADR-0087 route (the `spec-property-retirement` playbook): pick the route, the liveness-ledger entry, the conversion for stored metadata, generated baselines, forms, docs and pin tests. The lint rule `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` already suggests a parent field group instead.

## Not this card
- The field-group placement itself (#35889).
- Skills text (#35902).

## Acceptance
- Authoring `inlineEdit: true` follows the chosen retirement route (warning, conversion or refusal as the route says), and every gate the playbook names is green.

Reader: `domain:spec`. Blocked by #35921 merging.
